title: Trusted Human Interaction Transcript
description: Offline byte evidence for an approval interaction. This JSON and its channel/interaction/message identifiers are not an authenticity root. It contains the selected assistant/system presentation before the selected human response. A gate receiver must independently verify both message identities, roles, times, contents, actor, and approval target through an operator-pinned external authority query or provider signature; if unavailable, STOP/HUMAN.

content.description: Exact Unicode statement text. Offline validation hashes content encoded as UTF-8 with no added BOM or newline.

messages.description: messageId values are unique. Capture selects one assistant/system presentation message whose exact UTF-8 content equals challenge.presentationArtifact canonical bytes, followed by exactly one selected human response whose content equals canonicalResponse. External provenance binds both messages.
